# vercel telemetry

Allows you to enable or disable telemetry collection

```
vercel telemetry <command>
```

## Subcommands

### `vercel telemetry disable`

Disables telemetry collection

```
vercel telemetry disable
```

### `vercel telemetry enable`

Enables telemetry collection

```
vercel telemetry enable
```

### `vercel telemetry status`

Shows whether telemetry collection is enabled or disabled

```
vercel telemetry status
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
